title: Case Study: Optimizing Commercial Energy Efficiency with Dawnice 100kW/200kWh Peak Shaving ESS in Switzerland (May 2026)
summary: A 100kW/200kWh all-in-one system in Switzerland, dispatched for peak shaving and arbitrage.
challenge: Swiss commercial tariffs combine substantial time-of-use rates with demand charges, so a single monthly peak can set much of the bill.
solution: A 100kW/200kWh all-in-one ESS that caps peaks and shifts energy into cheaper periods.
result: Peak capping reduces the premium capacity charges the facility pays; the case study quotes an estimated payback for that saving.
